# Gemini CLI fixtures

These fixtures target **Gemini CLI 0.63.0**, checked in an isolated home and scratch project. Session records preserve the live JSONL shapes and token values; local paths, identifying IDs, project hashes and injected environment context have been replaced. No credentials or personal conversations are included. Tests use `FakeGemini`, never the installed CLI.

- [Terminal titles](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/v0.63.0/packages/cli/src/utils/windowTitle.ts): OSC 0, padded to 80 columns. `titles.json` marks live observations separately from source-derived variants. Working, ready, a thought subject (`ui.showStatusInTitle`), a fixed title (`ui.dynamicWindowTitle` off), a tool confirmation and a silent `sleep 65` were observed inside tmux. Hidden titles were checked against the source. There is no source exception for screen or Zellij; those were not checked live.
- [Chat recording](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/v0.63.0/packages/core/src/services/chatRecordingService.ts): a main-session header, whole-message updates by ID, and `$set` field replacements. `initial.jsonl` contains the CLI's own `<session_context>` in `$set.messages`, which is not a submitted prompt. Empty text, slash/help commands, `<hook_context>` and synthetic function responses also count as neither submitted prompts nor resumable user content. `prompt.jsonl` and `reply.jsonl` hold an ordinary prompt and response; `session.jsonl` is the reduced live session. `tools.jsonl` includes repeated Gemini message IDs, completed tool calls and synthetic user `functionResponse` messages. `resumed.jsonl` records a live resume: `$set.messages` restores the whole history, including thought and text parts, while preserving the original prompt and reply timestamps.
- [Token limits](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/v0.63.0/packages/core/src/core/tokenLimits.ts): `tokens.input` over 1,048,576, or 256,000 for Gemma 4. Cached, output and reasoning tokens are not added again.
- [Storage](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/v0.63.0/packages/core/src/config/storage.ts): `projects.json` maps canonical roots to slugs under `.gemini/tmp`; `.project_root` identifies a slug's owner. Main sessions are top-level files in `chats`, subagents live below a parent-session directory. The files are opened only for each append, so a process has no open handle linking it to its session.

Live `/compress` reported a reduction from 10,570 to 505 tokens, then replaced `messages` with initial context, a synthetic scratchpad/state snapshot and an acknowledgement, without saving new input-token usage. `compacted.jsonl` pins that replacement. cornercase clears obsolete usage until a real reply, instead of estimating the compressed percentage.

The unsaved `/model` picker changed the footer without writing a model change into the session. `/model set auto` did write an `info` message, `Model set to auto`. `/clear` created a new session file in the same process. `/stats` displayed statistics without adding a prompt, and `!printf shell-check` ran a shell command without a real user-prompt record. Local commands therefore return after Enter without claiming prompt confirmation. The `/model` footer column is an optional observation for picker changes, including when cwd is hidden or context and quota follow it; a hidden or truncated footer falls back to the session.

`trust.txt` preserves the question and selected options observed live: `Trust folder` is first, with no yes option. Enter accepted it and relaunched Gemini's child. No input-box/dialog check is installed: `>` occurs in picker help as well as the composer, and shell, YOLO and reverse-search inputs have other markers.

`--worktree` changes the child process's cwd before constructing storage; `--include-directories` adds workspace folders without changing that root. These were checked against the installed 0.63.0 source; no model calls were needed. Association follows Gemini children and requires a single CLI family per home and folder. It intentionally omits conversation data for two independent Gemini in the same folder, and does not inject `--session-id` because `/clear` and `/resume` would still change the association.
